milestones.title: Purchased the land
milestones.detail: Bought outright and documented, so the project is not building on borrowed ground.

milestones.title: Cement block perimeter wall
milestones.detail: A secure boundary around the full property, laid by local masons.

milestones.title: Steel entrance gate
milestones.detail: Fabricated and hung on site by Haitian steelworkers.

milestones.title: Poured the foundation
milestones.detail: Rebar tied and concrete poured for the main structure.

milestones.title: Two 10-foot septic tanks
milestones.detail: Dug and built for long-term sanitation, not a temporary fix.

milestones.title: Walls and columns
milestones.detail: Block walls and reinforced columns up to roof height.

milestones.title: Roof slab
milestones.detail: Formwork, steel, and the concrete pour that makes it a building.

milestones.title: Water and power connections
milestones.detail: Plumbing tie-in, cistern, and electrical service.
